ui_bugs.issue: Missing 'Cold' filter button — spec requires data-testid=outbound-filter-cold. filterBtns array at PortalOpsPage.jsx:1425-1433 only has [all, unscored, scored, high, contacted, replied_positive, not_interested]. Cold-filter entry must be added so founders can review cold prospects separately.

integration_issues.issue: On first observed run, clicking 'Scan replies' produced a red error toast 'IMAP poll failed' instead of the expected neutral 'IMAP imap_not_configured' toast. On the second clean run the toast did not appear at all (no toast text captured). The imapPoll() handler (PortalOpsPage.jsx:1393-1404) correctly branches on r.ok but the red toast suggests the axios call intermittently threw before returning — possibly because it was fired while busy=true from a preceding click. Recommend (a) disabling the button when busy, (b) logging the actual axios error in the catch block to diagnose, and (c) re-verifying in isolation.

action_items: Add 'cold' entry to filterBtns array in PortalOpsPage.jsx OutboundTab (line ~1425): ["cold", "Cold"]. Ensure data-testid=outbound-filter-cold renders and the filtered useMemo handles status=='cold'.

Investigate the intermittent 'IMAP poll failed' error toast — likely a double-click / busy-state race. Consider disabling buttons when busy=true and surfacing the real axios error message in the catch block.
critical_code_review_comments: outbound.py /seed-from-demos (line 1127-1131): no `max_per_run` override from payload. Hard-coded to 100. Fine for MVP; consider exposing a query-param cap for controlled back-fills of very large demo_sessions collections.

outbound.py _seed_demo_viewers (line 988-1102) reads demo_sessions with a 60-day cutoff AND ops_leads with the same 60-day cutoff. Any demo viewer older than 60 days will never be eligible for re-seeding even if they haven't converted. Document or expose this as a tunable constant DEMO_SEED_LOOKBACK_DAYS.

outbound.py _finalize_cold_prospects (line 624-637) uses FOLLOWUP_OFFSETS_DAYS[-1] (=8 days) as the cold-cutoff. That means a prospect who got all 4 emails and the 4th was sent less than 8 days ago is still 'contacted' not 'cold'. The spec says '4 emails + FU3 cadence (8 days) elapsed'. The implementation is correct but the constant coupling is subtle — extract MAX_COLD_GRACE_DAYS = FOLLOWUP_OFFSETS_DAYS[-1] for readability.
PortalOpsPage.jsx is now 2158 lines (>700 line guideline, up from 2068 last iteration). Same recommendation as last iter — split OutboundTab + sub-components into /pages/portal/outbound/*.jsx.

server.py imap-poll-now endpoint (line 3381-3388) constructs an ad-hoc class _A with email/token to pass to _require_outbound_founder. Every other outbound endpoint uses the OpsAuth Pydantic model via the router. Inconsistent auth pattern — consider moving this endpoint into the outbound router for uniformity or using a shared dependency.

frontend/src/lib/api.js helpers opsOutboundSeedFromDemos + opsOutboundImapPollNow (line 365-369) don't coerce non-ok HTTP responses uniformly. A 500 from backend currently throws; a 200 with ok:false is returned as data. Consumers must branch on both. Document in api.js or add a helper.

rca of the issue: Cold-filter-button missing: filterBtns array in PortalOpsPage.jsx:1425-1433 was updated for this iteration but the 'cold' tuple was omitted. Single-line fix: add ['cold', 'Cold'] to the array. The 'cold' status tone is already defined at line 723 so styling will work immediately. IMAP-poll toast anomaly: likely a double-click/busy race — the handler sets busy=true synchronously but the button is not disabled on the busy prop, so a rapid second click re-enters the handler and the axios call may race with the first one's response, causing an unhandled promise rejection that triggers the catch block's generic error toast. Mitigation: gate the onClick with `disabled={busy}` on the button.
